svg.text: D1: 4 × 8 ft entry • D2: 3.5 × 7 ft • D3: 3 × 7 ft • D4: 2.5 × 7 ft store slider
All opening sizes are width × height. Blank internal gaps are open connections; D / S labels identify doors.
*Great-room zone includes a 6 × 6 ft foyer. Dimensions are planning zones; finished clear sizes depend on walls.
Upper floor also mirrored to keep stairs aligned; its balcony and terrace now face the rear. W.I.C. = walk-in closet.
Windows are proposed openings: engineer to check lintels, glass design and openable/escape portions. Internal baths need exhaust.
Not constrained to the previous ₹45 lakh budget. Footprint and outdoor areas have not been approved for a specific site.
